【原视频简介】
Nvidia has finally rolled out DLSS 5 which is essentially an AI filter that takes game info and makes an educated prediction on more realistic representations of lighting. They call it "Neural Rendering, the future of graphics". The backlash has been wild. And the files leaked, sooo I thought I would go ahead and put it in as many games as I possibly could. This was a mistake.

Shoutout to all the people putting in the work to get these mods running!

__Here are some resources that helped me get it running in games__

Reshade tutorial
Ancient Gameplays: https://youtu.be/SK17YL-GiEY?si=f5MWBL92aSUB2gBC

Check the Renodx discord in the DLSS 5 channel pinned messages for latest updates on the DLLs + addons
https://discord.gg/renodx

You can also run it with Optiscaler instead for a bit more control (ONLY works for games with DLSS already in them): https://github.com/Dagherbou/OptiScaler_DLSSNR/releases

DLSS Bridge addon for DX11 and some Vulkan games: https://github.com/NIGos/dlss5-bridge/releases/tag/v1.4.12
(check the main GitHub page for tutorial)

DLSS Feed addon for games without DLSS entirely: https://github.com/jlrouzies-fr/DLSS5-Feeder/releases/tag/v0.14.0-beta.4
(Check the main GitHub page for tutorial. I couldn't get this working in Detroit Become Human sadly (kept freezing or crashing))
